risks.detailEn: The canon provides no matching definitions or inventories for KI, implemented systems, or ARCH counts.

transitions.fromZh: 阿汐听着水壶烧开，灰仍留在指尖
transitions.fromEn: Axi listens as the kettle boils; ash remains on her fingertip
transitions.toEn: The water has boiled; the ash has not returned to the fire
transitions.narrativeZh: 水壶自行烧开，阿汐没有催灰落下，也没有把它归还给火。
transitions.narrativeEn: The kettle boils on its own. Axi neither hurries the ash to fall nor returns it to the fire.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 阿汐把火调小，继续听水声。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Axi lowers the flame and keeps listening to the water.
transitions.atlasHookEn: The water boiled; the ash stayed.

transitions.fromZh: 潮退后，船底干痕仍在，薄簿合着
transitions.fromEn: At ebb, the hull mark remains and the ledger stays shut
transitions.toZh: 阿汐确认干痕未变，却不把它写入薄簿
transitions.toEn: Axi finds the mark unchanged and leaves it out of the ledger
transitions.narrativeZh: 潮水退去，干痕未变；阿汐不记录，也不追问。
transitions.narrativeEn: The tide recedes and the mark remains. Axi neither records it nor asks why.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 阿汐留着薄簿合拢，转身照看灶火。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Axi leaves the ledger closed and turns back to the stove.

transitions.fromZh: 摆停在最低处，阿汐不再等待交接
transitions.fromEn: The pendulum rests at its lowest point; Axi no longer waits for a handover
transitions.toZh: 摆仍停着，空位仍无人坐下
transitions.toEn: The pendulum remains still; the place beside it remains empty
transitions.narrativeZh: 阿汐不催摆动，也不替空位安排坐者，让停留保持原样。
transitions.narrativeEn: Axi neither urges the pendulum to swing nor assigns anyone to the empty place.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 摆与空位都维持原状，无人接手。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The pendulum and the empty place remain as they are; no one takes over.
transitions.atlasHookEn: The place beside the pendulum stays empty.

transitions.fromZh: 薄簿合着，灰留在指尖，盐留在门槛
transitions.fromEn: The ledger is shut; ash stays on Axi’s fingertip and salt by the threshold
transitions.toZh: 阿汐不再催促，也不要求灰或盐归位
transitions.toEn: Axi stops hurrying and asks neither ash nor salt to return
transitions.narrativeZh: 灰没有落下，盐没有移动；阿汐继续听火与水各自运行。
transitions.narrativeEn: The ash does not fall and the salt does not move. Axi listens as fire and water keep their own time.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 灶火照自己的火候燃着，阿汐不再替它们着急。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The fire keeps its own heat; Axi no longer hurries anything.
transitions.atlasHookEn: Neither ash nor salt is hurried.

atlasDraft.pZh: 清晨，灰仍在指尖，盐仍在门槛边。阿汐没有翻开薄簿。潮水退去，干痕仍在，木板轻轻收紧。她没有去看海。傍晚，灰还没有落。薄簿仍合着。有些痕迹淡了，也不必补记。
atlasDraft.pEn: At dawn, the ash still clung to Axi’s fingertip, and the salt remained by the threshold. She left the thin ledger shut. At ebb, the dry mark remained, and the boards tightened softly. She did not look toward the sea. By evening, the ash had not fallen. The ledger stayed closed. Some marks need no entry, even as they fade.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些印子，淡了也不必补记。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some marks need no entry when they fade.
